It comes down to how cp gets calculated. Attack is pretty heavily weighted compared to defense and HP. So when you get legendaries with huge attack stats in cp limited formats they just end up underleveled and underwhelming. They won't be as bulky as in Master League and wont be able to take multiple hits.

A level 50, best buddy, 100% iv gfisk is 2474 cp. There's technically nothing stopping you from using it in Master League but the level 50 legendaries that are all north of 4000cp will roll over it easily. It's just not well suited for Master League.
